request.question: Which separate Node SQLite driver should implement SUNNY's read-only FTS5 source service under the previously selected different_driver route?

options.better_sqlite3: Install exact better-sqlite3@13.0.3 (Node >=22). Its current official bundled configuration lists SQLITE_ENABLE_FTS5; synchronous prepared statements match the current minimal backend. Verify the installed binary's FTS5 and rerun the original schema/search tests.
options.sqlite3: Install exact sqlite3@6.0.1 (Node >=20.17). Its official repository is archived and marks the library unmaintained; asynchronous bindings would require adapting the current synchronous source backend. Verify the installed binary's FTS5 and rerun the original schema/search tests.

state.goal: Make existing SUNNY UI contract runnable against preserved imported sources without deciding research ontology.
state.user_constraint: Every possible implementation decision must be dictated by live Jev; latest live Jev selected a different SQLite Node driver, not Python helper or new Node runtime.
evidence: Original failing test: tests/server.test.mjs, no such module: fts5 with Node 22.14 built-in SQLite.
Actual built-in SQLite 3.47.2 reports ENABLE_FTS5=0; ordinary messages queries work.
Python SQLite 3.45.3 reports ENABLE_FTS5=1; actual SUNNY FTS query works.
npm registry currently reports better-sqlite3 13.0.3 engines Node >=22 and sqlite3 6.0.1 engines Node >=20.17.
https://github.com/TryGhost/node-sqlite3 marks repository archived and unmaintained.
state.acceptance: Installed driver must execute original FTS5 schema and pass source text, branch, query-binding, refused-write, traversal and byte-unchanged checks.
